confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 high season; not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel rates are least certain given seasonal swings and tourist-district pricing. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 2.5x). FX came from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates listing; the rate table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant anchors are calibrated to Bogota as the closest local-price comparable, moved toward Santiago for Cartagena's tourist-district premium. Hostel and hotel anchors are set above Bogota and Lima to reflect July high-season tourist demand, near or above Santiago levels.
